Teacher Svein:
Enhancing your Spirit requires Attribute XP that are given for killing attribute monsters.
You can check the attribute of a monster by targeting it.
There is a correlation between a monster's attribute and a Spirit that will be enhanced by killing it. So do not forget to check your current Spirit's attribute while hunting!
Water attribute monsters: Wind Attribute XP Fire attribute monsters: Water Attribute XP Earth attribute monsters: Fire Attribute XP Wind attribute monsters: Earth Attribute XP
